title: Storm Sorceress at Sea
description: A blue-haired sorceress in ornate armor floats above a stormy ocean, holding a glowing blue orb staff in one hand while casting swirling magical energy from the other. Below her, tall sailing ships battle massive turbulent waves beneath a dramatic swirling vortex of clouds, lightning, and golden sparks in the night sky.
prompt: A powerful blue-haired sorceress with flowing hair and ornate blue and gold armor floats dynamically above a raging stormy sea at night. She holds a tall ornate staff topped with a glowing blue orb in one hand and casts swirling streams of magical energy and runes from the other. Below her are tall sailing ships tossed by massive turbulent waves. The sky features a dramatic swirling vortex of dark blue clouds, golden lightning, and glowing particles. Epic fantasy style with dramatic lighting and dynamic composition.
